import json
from pathlib import Path


def test_retry_rehydrates_canonical_inventory_context():
    text = Path('backend/core/scheduler/jobs/inventarios_detector_job.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert "detalles_raw = registro.get('DetallesJSON')" in text
    assert "'folio_inicial': detalles.get('folio_inicial')" in text
    assert "'fecha_inicial': detalles.get('fecha_inicial')" in text
    assert "'fecha_inventario': detalles.get('fecha_inventario')" in text
    assert "'metadata': detalles.get('metadata', {})" in text


def test_new_tracking_persists_retry_context():
    text = Path('backend/core/scheduler/jobs/inventarios_detector_job.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '"fecha_inicial": inv.fecha_inicial' in text
    assert '"fecha_inventario": inv.fecha_inventario' in text
    assert '"metadata": inv.metadata' in text


def test_email_not_enabled_by_retry_fix():
    text = Path('backend/core/scheduler/jobs/inventarios_detector_job.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'SCHEDULER_INVENTARIOS_EMAIL_ENABLED' in text
    assert 'os.environ.get("SCHEDULER_INVENTARIOS_EMAIL_ENABLED", "false")' in text
